verses.1: I also introduce to you Phoebe, our sister. She is also a deacon in the church in Cæsarea.
verses.2: That you may honor her in a worthy manner among the holy ones. And let her be the one who will guide you in whatever you do. For she has indeed become a helper to many people, and also to me.
verses.3: May Aspasaaseth Prikhan and Akylan take care of my colleagues in Christ Jesus.
verses.4: Those who sacrificed their own lives for my soul. I don’t just myself thank them; all the churches of the nations also thank them.
verses.5: And also their household church. May Epaineon, my beloved, be blessed. He is from the beginning of Asia, down to Christ.
verses.6: You have taken from Maryam many things, she who has given you so much.
verses.7: You have taken away Andronicus and Iunia from my relatives and companions. They were among those who were officially designated as apostles, just like those who came before me in Christ.
verses.8: You have taken away my beloved Ambliathon from me.
verses.9: May you have received Ourbano as our partner in Christ, and Stachyn as my beloved companion.
verses.10: You have received the gift of faith in Christ. You have received those who come from Aristobulus.
verses.11: You have taken Hyródion, my relative. You have also taken those who were from Narqissos, those who lived in the city.
verses.12: You took away the flowers from Trifyana and Trifos. You also took away the beloved of Perisda, who had taken many flowers from her.
verses.13: You have taken the chosen one from his father, along with his mother and me.
verses.14: You have taken Asygriton, Flagon, Hermen, Patroban, Herman, and their brothers with them.
verses.15: You have taken Philologon and Iulia, as well as their sister. And also Olympian, along with all those who were with them, who were holy people.
verses.16: May you love one another in holy love. The churches of Christ will love you all.
verses.17: I ask you, brothers, to avoid those kinds of behaviors and actions that go against what you have learned from your teachings. Please get rid of them.
verses.18: For those who do not serve our Lord Christ in this way, they do not truly serve Him; instead, they act out of self-interest. Through their cunning and deceitfulness, they deceive the hearts of those who are innocent.
verses.19: For your obedience has come to all things. I rejoice over you. I want you to be wise in doing what is good, and courageous in facing the evil.
verses.20: But the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with you.
verses.21: Tymotheus, my colleague, and Lukios, Iason, and Sosipater, my relatives, take care of you.
verses.22: I beg you, I, Tertius, who wrote this letter in the king’s name.
verses.23: Gaius, a foreigner to me and to the entire church, claims your rights. Erastus, the administrator of the city, and Couzar, his brother, also claim your rights.
verses.24: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with you all. Amen.
